```{r}
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| results: hide

# Load in Packages
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(sf)
library(tmap)


# Load in data
ej <- sf::st_read(here::here(
    "data", "ejscreen", "EJSCREEN_2023_BG_StatePct_with_AS_CNMI_GU_VI.gdb"))

LA_crashes <- sf::st_read(here::here(
    "data", "SWITRS_LA", "Crashes.csv"))

map_inequal <- sf::st_read(here::here(
    "data", "mapping-inequality", "mapping-inequality-los-angeles.json"))


# Filter EjScreen data
California_ej <- ej |> 
    dplyr::filter(ST_ABBREV == "CA")


# Filter dataset to a county 
LA_county_ej <- California_ej |> 
    dplyr::filter(CNTY_NAME == "Los Angeles County")

```


```{r}
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| results: hide

# Check coordinate systems for compatibility
st_crs(LA_county_ej)
st_crs(LA_crashes)
st_crs(map_inequal)


# Quick test to see
st_crs(LA_county_ej) == st_crs(map_inequal)


# Change coorindate systems
map_inequal_transform <- st_transform(map_inequal, crs = st_crs(LA_county_ej))


# Check to see CRS's match
if(st_crs(map_inequal_transform) == st_crs(LA_county_ej)){
  print("it's a match!")
} else {
  print("still not a match")
}

```


## Part 1. Legacy of redlining in current environmental (in)justice


```{r}

tm_shape(LA_county_ej) +

    tm_polygons(
        lwd = 0.15, 
        col = "black") +

tm_shape(map_inequal, is.main = TRUE) +

    tm_polygons(
        fill = "grade", 
        lwd = 0.2, 
        fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Redline Grade"),
        fill.scale = tm_scale(values = "-plasma"))  +

tm_compass(size = 2, text.size = 0.7, position = c("left", "bottom")) + 

tm_scalebar(width = 8, text.size = 0.5, position = c("left", "bottom")) + 

tm_title("HOLC Redlining Grades in Los Angeles County", size = 1.0, position = tm_pos_out("center", "top", pos.h = "left", pos.v = "bottom"))

```
